document.abstract: This recommended practice defines constraints on the VC-2 video compression specification to provide a mezzanine level compression coding. It defines coding constraints such that source video of 1920 × 1080 pixels using 4:2:2 sampling at 50, 60 and 60/1.001 frames per second can be compressed by a factor of approximately 2.5 to 1 resulting in a compressed bit-rate that permits carriage over a single-link SDI operating at 1.5 Gb/s. — This document defines a VC-2 bit-stream for video compressed according to this practice. It also defines an application specific level for VC-2 compression.
